name: PokeA_CompletePicketBridge
note: Seven-tile timber span with close pickets, caps, deck, beams and four inferred bank piles.

name: PokeC_DownstreamStoneBridge
note: Downstream uncovered bridge: dark masonry, three principal arch bays and small end openings, pale slab paving, solid brown timber guards.

name: PokeD_FourArchBridge
note: Four long arches, broad cobbled carriageway, pale solid parapets and rounded pier noses; complete 20-tile scene in one file with two internal halves.

name: PokeD_SingleArchBridge
note: Southern short river bridge; single arch, cobbles and matching parapets.

name: PokeD_StoneOverpass
note: Eastern short arched road overpass. Terrain approaches, side stair and nearby lower terrace remain separate.

name: PokeF_PondSlatCrossing
note: Four broad planks across the pond neck, with visible gaps and end fasteners; underside stringers inferred.

name: PokeH_FarmPicketBridge
note: Image clips the far end. Visible 128-pixel span is completed to a symmetric ten-tile bridge; full unseen length is an explicit estimate.

name: PokeI_ArchedTimberBridge
note: Upper west river crossing: shallow bowed timber deck with pale close-spaced rails. Uses later building calibration of 9.5 displayed pixels/tile.

name: PokeI_FlatTimberBridge
note: Lower west crossing; shorter and flat, with paired pale timber rails.

name: PokeI_NarrowPlankBridge
note: North-south central crossing with broad transverse plank joints and low edge beams. Rotate this X-running model 90 degrees.

name: PokeM_DiagonalDeckBridge
note: Gold diagonal-board deck, timber border and four light metal L-corner plates. Hidden beams/short bank supports inferred; no rail added.

name: PokeP_GullyPlankBridge
note: Repeated east-west gully crossings: six-tile deck plus bank-anchor margin, three independent-looking posts at each corner; no connecting rails.

name: PokeP_ShortGullyBridge
note: Shorter north-south five-tile crossing, same construction; rotate 90 degrees. Adjacent gray diagonal ramp is terrain stairs, not part of this bridge.

name: PokeS_IvyStoneBridge
note: Eastern pale garden bridge over water: slab paving, single open arch, solid coping and ivy. Other pale linear details are garden walls/edging, already covered.

name: PokeT_TubularRailBridge
note: Eight-tile timber crossing with rounded metal hoop rails. Northern/southern horizontal copies and the two vertical views reuse this model with rotations.

name: PokeU_ShortIslandBridge
note: Upper floating-island crossing, four broad plank sections; low underside ties and bank anchors inferred, no handrail.

name: PokeU_LongIslandBridge
note: Lower crossing is six plank sections long. Shallow sag and hidden ties inferred; same source palette as upper span.
